entries.name: Booker Collins

expected.charges: Attempted murder of a police officer (Milwaukee, September 1969); one of the "Milwaukee Three"

updates.sentence: Thirty years for attempted murder, imposed September 22, 1970. Previously sentenced November 4, 1969 to one year at the Milwaukee County House of Correction for resisting an officer. The federal court records discharge from that earlier sentence on September 5, 1970, followed by confinement at Waupun on the attempted-murder conviction. Discharge of the earlier sentence does not establish release from all custody; the final release date remains unverified.

entries.rationale: Contemporary movement newspaper explicitly reports arrest and jailing September 22, 1969. Federal opinion separates 1969 misdemeanor sentences from later attempted-murder custody; do not substitute discharge of one sentence for final release.

entries.name: Earl Leverette

expected.charges: Attempted murder of a police officer (Milwaukee, September 1969); one of the "Milwaukee Three"

updates.sentence: Ten-year sentence reported for the later attempted-murder case. Previously sentenced November 4, 1969 to one year at the Milwaukee County House of Correction for resisting an officer. A January 1971 federal decision records that he had left parole supervision with 53 days remaining on that earlier sentence. He was out on bail when the attempted-murder trial began September 14, 1970 and disappeared during trial. Dates of release, return to custody, and the later sentence remain unverified.
